canonical_draft_selection.action: Adopt security measures for personal-data processing
canonical_draft_selection.subject_scope: Data controller; the inserted article belongs to Law21719 article primero amending Law19628
canonical_draft_selection.conditions_temporality: Measure selection considers state of the art, costs, nature/scope/context/purposes, likelihood and severity of risks and data types. No uniform disposition effective date is asserted.

canonical_draft_selection.action: Ensure security properties of processing systems
canonical_draft_selection.subject_scope: Measures applied by the data controller under the same inserted security provision
canonical_draft_selection.conditions_temporality: Confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience are required properties of the same security measure evaluation; this is not a blanket legal compliance assertion.
